intent: Make the Companion breathable and modular on desktop while preserving mobile progressive disclosure.
changes: Reduced the desktop Companion width to 480px and maximum height to 760px.
Collapsed profile, privacy and workflow context behind an accessible information-and-tools drawer.
Made quick prompts a two-column desktop module while preserving horizontal mobile prompts.
Removed horizontal message overflow and retained one stable vertical message scroll.
Kept privacy and tool details in the modular drawer instead of a persistent footer.

qa.excluded_reason: One unrelated execution-interest scenario was classified by QA as bad_test because it expected a form element that does not exist.

source_alignment.note: This receipt records the exact production snapshot; the AppDeploy source export remains separate from GitHub main.
